title: Enhancing Centelloside Production in Centella asiatica Hairy Root Lines through Metabolic Engineering of Triterpene Biosynthetic Pathway Early Genes.
authors: Alcalde, Miguel Angel; Palazon, Javier; Bonfill, Mercedes; Hidalgo-Martinez, Diego
one_liner_zh: 该文通过代谢工程改造积雪草毛状根中三萜生物合成途径基因以提升积雪草苷产量，属于植物代谢工程与次生代谢研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Centella asiatica is a medicinal plant with a rich tradition of use for its therapeutic properties. Among its bioactive compounds are centellosides, a group of triterpenoid secondary metabolites whose potent pharmacological activities have attracted significant attention. Metabolic engineering has emerged as a powerful biotechnological tool to enhance the production of target compounds. In this study, we explored the effects of overexpressing the squalene synthase (SQS) gene and transcription factor TSAR2 on various aspects of C. asiatica hairy root lines: the expression level of centelloside biosynthetic genes, morphological traits, as well as squalene, phytosterol, and centelloside content. Three distinct categories of transformed lines were obtained: LS, harboring At-SQS; LT, overexpressing TSAR2; and LST, simultaneously carrying both transgenes. These lines displayed noticeable alterations in morphological traits, including changes in branching rate and biomass production. Furthermore, we observed that the expression of T-DNA genes, particularly aux2 and rolC genes, significantly modulated the expression of pivotal genes involved in centelloside biosynthesis. Notably, the LS lines boasted an elevated centelloside content but concurrently displayed reduced phytosterol content, a finding that underscores the intriguing antagonistic relationship between phytosterol and triterpene pathways. Additionally, the inverse correlation between the centelloside content and morphological growth values observed in LS lines was countered by the action of TSAR2 in the LST and LT lines. This difference could be attributed to the simultaneous increase in the phytosterol content in the TSAR2-expressing lines, as these compounds are closely linked to root development. Overall, these discoveries offer valuable information for the biotechnological application of C. asiatica hairy roots and their potential to increase centelloside production.
abstract_zh: 积雪草（Centella asiatica）是一种药用植物，因其治疗特性而拥有丰富的传统使用历史。其生物活性化合物中包含积雪草苷（centellosides），这是一组三萜类次生代谢物，其强大的药理活性引起了广泛关注。代谢工程（metabolic engineering）已成为一种强大的生物技术工具，用于提高目标化合物的产量。在本研究中，我们探讨了过表达角鲨烯合酶（squalene synthase, SQS）基因和转录因子TSAR2对积雪草毛状根系的多个方面的影响：积雪草苷生物合成基因的表达水平、形态特征，以及角鲨烯、植物甾醇和积雪草苷含量。获得了三类不同的转化根系：LS，携带At-SQS；LT，过表达TSAR2；以及LST，同时携带两种转基因。这些根系在形态特征上表现出显著变化，包括分枝率和生物量产量的改变。此外，我们观察到T-DNA基因（特别是aux2和rolC基因）的表达显著调节了参与积雪草苷生物合成的关键基因的表达。值得注意的是，LS根系具有较高的积雪草苷含量，但同时显示出降低的植物甾醇含量，这一发现强调了植物甾醇和三萜途径之间有趣的拮抗关系。此外，在LS根系中观察到的积雪草苷含量与形态生长值之间的负相关性，被TSAR2在LST和LT根系中的作用所抵消。这种差异可能归因于表达TSAR2的根系中植物甾醇含量的同时增加，因为这些化合物与根系发育密切相关。总体而言，这些发现为积雪草毛状根系的生物技术应用及其提高积雪草苷产量的潜力提供了宝贵信息。
